data.name: Rehearsals_List_PageTitle

data.comment: aria-label on the Rehearsals search input.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_LoadingText
data.comment: Status text shown while the Rehearsals list loads.

data.comment: Shown when a search returns nothing. {SearchTerm} = the text the user typed.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_DateColumn
data.comment: Rehearsals grid column header — rehearsal date.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_TimeColumn
data.comment: Rehearsals grid column header — rehearsal time.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_AttendanceColumn
data.comment: Rehearsals grid column header — recorded attendance rate.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_NotesColumn
data.comment: Rehearsals grid column header — rehearsal notes.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_AttendanceNotRecorded
data.comment: Shown in the Attendance column when no attendance rate has been recorded.

data.comment: aria-label on the date button that opens a rehearsal's recorded attendance. {Date} = the rehearsal date.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_RecordAttendanceButton
data.comment: Button that opens the attendance-recording grid for a rehearsal.

data.comment: aria-label on the Record Attendance button. {Date} = the rehearsal date.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_RecordedText

data.comment: Button that prints the attendance roll PDF for a rehearsal.

data.comment: aria-label on the Print Roll button. {Date} = the rehearsal date.

data.name: Rehearsals_List_RollNoMembers
data.value: No active members found — nothing to print.
data.comment: Shown when Print Roll is used but there are no active members.

data.value: Unable to print roll. Please try again.
data.comment: Shown when generating the attendance roll PDF fails.

data.value: Unable to load rehearsals. Please try again.
data.comment: Shown when the Rehearsals list fails to load.

data.comment: Browser tab title for the schedule-rehearsal form.

data.comment: Page heading on the schedule-rehearsal form.

data.comment: Schedule-rehearsal form field label — date.

data.name: Rehearsals_Form_TimeLabel
data.comment: Schedule-rehearsal form field label — time.

data.comment: Validation message shown when the time field is left blank.

data.name: Rehearsals_Form_NotesLabel
data.comment: Schedule-rehearsal form field label — notes.

data.name: Rehearsals_Form_ScheduleButton
data.comment: Submit button on the schedule-rehearsal form.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_PageTitleView
data.comment: Browser tab title when viewing a rehearsal's already-recorded attendance.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_PageTitleRecord
data.comment: Browser tab title when recording attendance for a rehearsal.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_HeadingView
data.comment: Page heading when viewing a rehearsal's already-recorded attendance.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_HeadingRecord
data.comment: Page heading when recording attendance for a rehearsal.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_BackButton
data.comment: Link back to the Rehearsals list from the attendance grid.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_RecordedBanner
data.value: Attendance recorded at {Rate}% attendance rate. Records are immutable.
data.comment: Info banner shown when attendance has already been recorded. {Rate} = the stored attendance rate to one decimal place.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_NoRecords
data.value: No attendance records found for this rehearsal.
data.comment: Shown when a rehearsal is marked recorded but has no attendance rows.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_AttendedColumn
data.comment: Attendance grid column header — whether the member attended.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_PaidColumn
data.comment: Attendance grid column header — whether the attendance fee was paid.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_MemberColumn
data.comment: Attendance grid column header — member name.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_FeeColumn
data.comment: Attendance grid column header — the attendance fee for the row.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_AttendedAriaLabel
data.comment: aria-label on a row's Attended checkbox. {MemberName} = the member's name.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_PaidAriaLabel
data.comment: aria-label on a row's Paid checkbox in the read-only recorded view. {MemberName} = the member's name.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_MarkPaidAriaLabel
data.comment: aria-label on a row's Paid checkbox while recording. {MemberName} = the member's name.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_SelectAllAriaLabel
data.comment: aria-label on the header checkbox that marks every member as attended.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_SelectAllLabel
data.comment: Label beside the header checkbox that marks every member as attended.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_FutureNotice
data.comment: Shown when the rehearsal is in the future. {Date} = the rehearsal date, long form.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_NoActiveMembers
data.value: No active members found. Add members before recording attendance.
data.comment: Shown when there are no active members to record attendance for.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_OwedBadge
data.comment: Badge shown beside the fee when a member attended but has not paid.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_SaveButton
data.comment: Button that saves the recorded attendance for a rehearsal.

data.name: Rehearsals_Attendance_NotFound
data.comment: Shown when the requested rehearsal id does not exist.
